text: 腾讯控股(00700.HK)公告，金融科技及企业服务业务二零二六年第二季的收入同比增长9%至人民币603亿元。金融科技服务收入增长主要得益于商业支付、理财及消费贷款服务的收入增加。企业服务收入增长主要受我们的云服务收入增长所驱动，得益于AI相关服务需求上升、持续拓展国际市场以及更为有利的定价环境。
text_en: Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) announced that revenue from its Financial Technology and Enterprise Services business for Q2 2026 rose 9% year-on-year to RMB 60.3 billion. Growth in FinTech services revenue was mainly due to increased revenue from commercial payments, wealth management, and consumer loan services. Enterprise services revenue growth was driven by our cloud services revenue growth, supported by rising demand for AI-related services, continued international expansion, and a more favorable pricing environment.
